instruction: Implement checkpoint.save(initial, name, text, crash) using the provided in-memory FileSystem adapter. This task models atomic checkpoint ordering; it does not claim real filesystem crash durability. initial maps names to strings, and name + ".tmp" is guaranteed absent. Always write text to name + ".tmp" first. If crash is false, atomically replace name using the temporary file. If crash is true, model a failure immediately before replacement: remove the temporary file and preserve the original destination (or its absence). Return {"files": final_files, "events": adapter_events, "saved": not crash}. Preserve all unrelated files and initial. Required event order is write then replace on success, write then remove on failure. Do not change memfs.py or write host files.
